sections.text_helper: Section 55.3.7 "ADC triggers" in chapter 55 (Basic timers (TIM6/TIM7/TIM18)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2750.
sections.section_content:
The timer can generate an ADC triggering event with various internal signals, such as reset,
enable or compare events.
Note: The clock of the slave peripherals (such as timer, ADC) receiving the tim_trgo signal must
be enabled prior to receiving events from the master timer, and the clock frequency
(prescaler) must not be changed on-the-fly while triggers are received from the master
timer.
